2608.28455.title: ARC-CT: Anatomy-Routed Contrastive Vision-Language Learning for 3D Chest CT
2608.28455.paper_summary: Contrastive vision-language learning uses paired chest CT volumes and radiology reports to learn abnormality classifiers without manually annotated labels. However, two characteristics of chest CT challenge conventional global contrastive learning. First, many critical abnormalities are small or anatomically localized, and pooling an en- tire volume into a single embedding may dilute their visual evidence. Second, the standard contrastive objective treats every other scan in a batch as a negative. Because many chest CTs share abnormalities, this objective incorrectly pushes co-positive pairs apart. We propose Anatomy-Routed Contrastive Learning for 3D Chest CT (ARC-CT), a region-aware framework that addresses these limitations using only la- bels extracted from reports by an LLM, with no manual annotations or bounding boxes. ARC-CT combines three components: (1) an Anato- myQFormer localizing evidence via queries constrained by automatically generated organ masks; (2) a label-Jaccard soft InfoNCE objective in- tegrating the standard one-hot target with the label-set overlap of each pair, which reduces false-negative penalties between studies that share clinical findings; and (3) an organ-level alignment loss connecting mask- pooled visual features to organ-specific report text extracted offline with a large language model. ARC-CT achieves a 0.86 mask-free macro AUC across 18 abnormalities using a compact 3D ResNet-18 backbone. Over- all, ARC-CT outperforms both comparable efficient baselines and sev- eral larger transformer models. Our code and weights are available at https://github.com/arc-ct/arc-ct.
2608.28455.paper_summary_zh: 對比視覺-語言學習使用配對的胸部 CT 體積和放射學報告來學習異常分類器，而不需要手動標註的標籤。<lb/>然而，胸部 CT 的兩個特徵對傳統的全局對比學習提出了挑戰。<lb/>首先，許多關鍵的異常是小型或解剖學上局部化的，將整個體積匯聚成單一嵌入可能會稀釋它們的視覺證據。<lb/>其次，標準的對比目標將批次中的每個其他掃描視為負樣本。<lb/>由於許多胸部 CT 共享異常，這一目標不正確地將共同正樣本推開。<lb/>我們提出了 3D 胸部 CT 的解剖路由對比學習（ARC-CT），這是一個區域感知框架，利用從報告中提取的標籤來解決這些限制，無需手動標註或邊界框。<lb/>ARC-CT 結合了三個組件：<lb/>(1) 一個通過自動生成的器官掩膜約束的查詢本地化證據的 AnatomyQFormer；<lb/>(2) 一個標籤-Jaccard 軟 InfoNCE 目標，將標準的一次性目標與每對的標籤集重疊整合，減少在共享臨床發現的研究之間的假陰性懲罰；<lb/>(3) 一個器官級對齊損失，將掩膜匯聚的視覺特徵連接到離線提取的器官特定報告文本，該文本使用大型語言模型。<lb/>ARC-CT 在 18 種異常上實現了 0.86 的無掩膜宏 AUC，使用緊湊的 3D ResNet-18 主幹。<lb/>總的來說，ARC-CT 超越了可比較的高效基準和幾個較大的Transformer模型。<lb/>我們的代碼和權重可在 https://github.com/arc-ct/arc-ct 獲得。
